name: home
description: The home tab: a soft house drawn in one line, its arched door cut into the base (the Figma bottom bar).

name: search
description: Search: a lens with a glint and a handle.

name: cart
description: The cart: a shopping basket with a rim, three slats and a round handle (the Figma bottom bar).

name: orders
description: My orders: a carry bag with a tick.

name: account
description: The account: a round head over soft shoulders (the Figma bottom bar).

name: settings
description: Settings: a cog of eight rounded teeth.

name: back
description: Back: a heavy rounded chevron, drawn pointing left and flipped in RTL (the Figma headers).

name: close
description: Close or dismiss: a cross.

name: chevron-down
description: Open a list: a chevron pointing down, for selects and menus (D.8).

name: more
description: More actions: three dots in a row.

name: menu
description: Opens the sidebar on a phone: three equal lines (D.10).

name: filter
description: Filter and sort: two sliders with knobs.

name: add
description: Add one more, or a new item: a plus.

name: remove
description: Take one away: a minus.

name: delete
description: Delete: a bin with a handled lid and three slats (the Figma cart).

name: edit
description: Edit: a pencil over a little wavy stroke of handwriting.

name: confirm
description: Confirm or done: a tick with a soft elbow.

name: retry
description: Try again: a circular arrow, clockwise.

name: share
description: Share: an arrow rising out of an open tray.

name: camera
description: Take a photo: a camera with a round lens.

name: image
description: A picture or gallery: a frame with the sun and two hills.

name: info
description: Information: an i in a circle.

name: warning
description: A warning: an exclamation mark in a rounded triangle.

name: error
description: An error: a cross in a circle.

name: success
description: Success: a tick in a circle.

name: bell
description: Notifications: a bell whose dome opens onto a notification dot (the Figma home).

name: offline
description: No connection: a cloud struck through.

name: clock
description: Time and timers: a stopwatch, for delivery times.

name: calendar
description: A date: a calendar page with two rings, for date fields (D.8).

name: drop-pin
description: A place on the map: the logo's drop as a pin over a ground line (brand expression §2).

name: map
description: The map: a folded map holding a small drop.

name: route
description: The route and navigation: a winding road from a start dot to an end dot.

name: motorcycle
description: The captain's scooter with its delivery box and two speed lines, drawn facing right and flipped in RTL (the Figma bottom bar).

name: car
description: A car, drawn facing right and flipped in RTL.

name: restaurant
description: A restaurant: a storefront with a scalloped awning.

name: plate
description: A dish: a bowl with three wavy lines of steam.

name: house
description: A delivery address: a house with a chimney and a heart for a window.

name: cash
description: Cash: two stacked banknotes.

name: wallet
description: The wallet and its balance: a wallet with a flap and a clasp tab.

name: discount
description: A discount: a flame holding a percent sign (the Figma offers category).

name: receipt
description: A receipt or bill: a slip with a torn edge and lines.

name: gift
description: A gift: a box with a ribbon and a bow.

name: phone
description: Call: a handset with two sound waves.

name: chat
description: Chat and support: a round speech bubble with three dots.

name: star
description: A rating: a five-pointed star.

name: heart
description: A favourite: a plump heart with a shine (the Figma bottom bar).

name: language
description: The language setting: a globe.
